content.title: HB18-1245 Prohibit Conversion Therapy Mental Health Provider
content.text: HB18-1245 Type Bill Session 2018 Regular Session Subjects Business & Economic Development Children & Domestic Matters Concerning a prohibition against a mental health care provider engaging in conversion therapy with a patient under eighteen years of age. Bill Summary: The bill prohibits a licensed physician specializing in psychiatry or a licensed, certified, or registered mental health care provider from engaging in conversion therapy with a patient under 18 years of age. A licensee who engages in these efforts is subject to disciplinary action by the appropriate licensing board. 'Conversion therapy' means efforts that seek to change an individual's sexual orientation, including efforts to change behaviors or gender expressions or to eliminate or reduce sexual or romantic attraction or feelings toward individuals of the same sex.(Note: This summary applies to the reengrossed version of this bill as introduced in the second house.)
